sections.heading: Boxes Sized to Garments, Not Guesswork
sections.text: Fashion Brand Packaging Boxes Sized to Garments, Not Guesswork Apparel packaging fails in boring ways: boxes a size too big so the fold collapses in transit, interiors that snag knits, lids that crush under stacking. We size each box to the folded garment spec — tees, hoodies, denim, scarves — so the piece arrives showroom-folded. The tissue system is part of the design: colour-matched sheets pre-folded to the box, sealed with your branded sticker. Interiors are smooth-lined with no exposed board edges to catch loops or silk. The magnetic lid opens flat for the reveal shot. Cream, black and kraft are stocked; any Pantone from 500 pcs. Ships flat option available for volume programs (see collapsible magnetic boxes ). Explore the fashion packaging solutions page .

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Questions Frequently Asked Questions How do you size boxes for clothing? Send the folded-garment dimensions (or the garment itself) — we cut the box to that spec so the fold can't shift or collapse in transit. Will the interior snag knitwear or silk? No — interiors are smooth-lined with sealed edges, no exposed board or raw cuts that catch loops, silk or embroidery. Do you supply matching tissue and seal stickers? Yes, colour-matched tissue arrives pre-folded to the box footprint with printed seal stickers, keeping packing-line output identical. Is there a lower-freight option for volume? Yes — a collapsible flat-ship version of the same look cuts international freight by roughly 60% at multi-store volumes. What is the MOQ? 200 pcs in stocked cream, black or kraft; custom Pantone exteriors start at 500 pcs.
